description:
Create a new central cooling plant in the 4StoreyBuilding project. Navigate to the Water-Side HVAC module and create two specific components:

1. A Circulation Loop named 'Primary CHW Loop':
   - Type: Chilled Water
   - Design Cool T (Supply Setpoint): 44.0 F

2. An Air-Cooled Chiller named 'Main Air-Cooled Chiller':
   - Attached to: Primary CHW Loop
   - Type: Electric Air-Cooled
   - Efficiency: 1.05 kW/ton

Save the project when finished. Do NOT run the simulation.
